title: 美国PPI数据爆冷：油价气价推高通胀，美联储月底会议悬念陡增
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: With your economic data, retail sales, initial job was claims and PPI, and the current has more, hey, Amda.
segments.zh: 来看经济数据，零售销售、初请失业金和PPI，还有更多内容，嘿，Amda。

segments.en: So it looks like upside, surprise on producer prices, John.
segments.zh: 看起来生产者价格超预期上行，John。

segments.en: At producer prices, on year 6.3, estimated 5.4, and in fact on the month 1.3 versus 0.6.
So PPI on a headline basis looking hot, remember that feeds into the Fed's preferred inflation gauge of CPE.
segments.zh: 整体PPI看起来偏热，记住这会传导至美联储偏好的通胀指标CPE。

segments.en: So that's important. Retail sales on a headline basis also be the expectations 0.8 versus 0.3.
segments.zh: 这很重要。整体零售销售也超预期，0.8%对0.3%。

segments.en: The thing to remember there though, of course, is that number is probably inflated by higher gas prices anyway.
segments.zh: 不过要记住，这个数字可能被更高的汽油价格推高了。

segments.en: So it's a stronger retail sales number, but probably reflecting what's going on at the pump.
segments.zh: 所以零售销售更强，但可能反映了加油站的情况。

segments.en: We'll need to see the control there to get a better gauge on the inflation story.
segments.zh: 我们需要看控制组数据，才能更好判断通胀情况。

segments.en: So I think at first glance, stronger than expected PPI numbers, we'll have to see the details of how to calculate CPE.
segments.zh: 所以乍一看，PPI强于预期，我们得看计算CPE的细节。

segments.en: But it all means into the idea that inflation right now remains hot.
segments.zh: 但这一切都意味着当前通胀仍然偏热。

segments.en: And of course, that's keeping pressure on the Fed. And do you take your time over a second, Luke?
segments.zh: 这当然给美联储带来压力。卢克，你能稍等一下吗？

segments.en: I'll get through to what's happening elsewhere. You mentioned the control group.
segments.zh: 我来看看其他地方的情况。你提到了控制组。

segments.en: Control group, a bit softer than expected. It came in at 0.1 on retail sales.
segments.zh: 控制组比预期略软。零售销售为0.1。

segments.en: The expectation was 0.3. PPI looks hot.
The jobs market does not look like a problem with claims at 1.99 and the estimate was 200.
segments.zh: 就业市场似乎没问题，申请人数为1.99，预期是200。

segments.en: We are always around 200K. Our job was claims week after week after week so we can park that story.
segments.zh: 我们总是在200K左右。每周的申请数据都是这样，所以可以搁置这个话题。

segments.en: Focus on what's happening with PPI. Hard than expected on PPI.
segments.zh: 关注PPI的情况。PPI比预期更强劲。

segments.en: Hotter than expected on course CPE. Raising the question about how life this meeting might be at the end of this month.
segments.zh: 核心PCE也比预期更热。这引发了关于本月底会议可能如何的疑问。
